findings.description: Stripe Checkout is created with each line item quantity forced to 1, so totals undercharge whenever any cart line has quantity greater than 1.
reproSteps: Open http://127.0.0.1:5173/, add Organic Bananas and click Add twice (or use + so quantity is 2).
Optionally add another product (e.g. 2% Milk) to see a larger mismatch.
Click Checkout and compare the Stripe-hosted total to the in-app cart total.
Alternatively POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/checkout/session with one item price 3.49 and quantity 2, then retrieve the session: amount_total is 349 instead of 698.
findings.observedBehavior: In-app cart total matched sum(price × quantity) (e.g. 2×$3.49 + milk = $11.27), but Stripe Checkout showed $7.78 with only one banana line; API-created session had amount_total_cents 349 and line item quantity 1 for quantity=2 in the request.
findings.expectedBehavior: Stripe Checkout total must equal the in-app cart total exactly (e.g. two bananas at $3.49 must charge $6.98, with line item quantity 2 or equivalent).

findings.description: When the cart is empty, the Checkout control is omitted rather than shown in a disabled state.
reproSteps: Open http://127.0.0.1:5173/ with an empty cart (remove all items with -).
Look in the cart aside for a Checkout button.
findings.observedBehavior: Cart shows “No items yet.” and there is no Checkout button in the DOM.
findings.expectedBehavior: Probe instructions required a Checkout button that is disabled when the cart is empty (still visible but not actionable).
domHints: aside.cart first paragraph when empty ("No items yet.")

findings.description: Browser console showed repeated failed network requests (including product images and Stripe-related resources) during the cart-checkout probe.
reproSteps: Open http://127.0.0.1:5173/ with developer tools console open.
Load the shop and proceed through add-to-cart and Checkout as usual.
findings.observedBehavior: Multiple errors such as net::ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED for images.unsplash.com photo URLs and Stripe-related hosts; Stripe JS also logged that some payment method types are not activated.
findings.expectedBehavior: Product images and Stripe assets should load without connection-closed failures under normal network conditions; console should be free of spurious errors during a standard checkout probe.
consoleErrors: [Stripe js] The following payment method types are not activated: link, klarna, amazon_pay
